name: fskill
description: Engineering workflow skills for Codex. Twenty workflow skills plus explicit /mode session routing. Direct commands remain available.

interface.longDescription: fskill packages twenty engineering skills in five groups: decide, build, ship, read and write, and leave something the next session can use. /mode routes only after you enter it. Enter any skill with /name or $name. A similar word does not start that workflow.
defaultPrompt: Use fskill think to plan this change
Use fskill check to review this diff
Use fskill hunt to debug this failure
